summary: P0 ABC deliveryService enum single-source-of-truth verified end-to-end. Backend endpoint returns exactly the 7 documented codes with default OTG and no OTB/WCL. abc-submit rejects OTB/WCL/invalid codes with status='validation_failed' and accepts all 7 valid codes with MOCK-CONF-* confirmations. Default OTG regression passes. Frontend AbcOrderPanel dropdown (data-testid abc-delivery-service) is populated from the backend endpoint and lists exactly the 7 services (Our Truck — Ground/Roof/Window, Customer Pickup, Express Pickup, Common Carrier, Third-Party Carrier); the legacy OTB (Boom / Rooftop) and WCL (Will Call — Customer Pickup) options are absent.
critical_code_review_comments: Nice: DELIVERY_SERVICES/DEFAULT_DELIVERY_SERVICE/is_valid_delivery_service centralized in backend/integrations/abc_supply/orders.py and consumed by both the /abc/delivery-services endpoint and abc_submit validation — frontend and backend cannot drift.

Frontend AbcOrderPanel.jsx swallows the enum-fetch error silently (line ~69). Consider a toast/log so a broken endpoint is observable in dev; behaviour is otherwise correct (Select falls back to just the current code).
seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates its own ABC-linked PO (notes=TEST_P0_DELIVERY_SVC) via POST /api/purchase-orders; not cleaned up (matches existing ABC test pattern).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_abc_delivery_services_enum.py must be run with -o addopts= (or single-worker) because it disconnects/reconnects ABC in a module-scoped autouse fixture — pytest.ini's default xdist parallelism races the same fixture with the sibling test_abc_delivery_appointment_contract.py / test_abc_order_comments_contract.py files. All three ABC contract test files individually pass. Frontend dropdown labels shown in the UI: Our Truck — Ground / Our Truck — Roof / Our Truck — Window / Customer Pickup / Express Pickup / Common Carrier / Third-Party Carrier.
rca of the issue: Prior UI-hardcoded list included OTB and WCL which are no longer in ABC's Place Orders deliveryService enum. Fixed by making backend/integrations/abc_supply/orders.py the single source of truth (7 codes; default OTG), exposing GET /api/purchase-orders/abc/delivery-services, adding server-side rejection in abc_submit via is_valid_delivery_service(), and switching AbcOrderPanel.jsx to fetch the enum on panel open.
